name: Elisa the Innkeeper - A new customer arrives!
source:
A follow up to Elisa: the Innkeeper - you play a young noble visiting Elisa's famous inn, and there are 5 beautiful employees (including Elisa) available for you to date.

Even if these girls are outrageously gorgeous, they are so well known for the very reason that nobody could ever manage to conquer them.
Therefore it will be a tough challenge, nothing - and nobody - can be taken for granted.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/704690/Elisa_Seduce_the_Innkeeper/?snr=1_7_7_comingsoon_150_5]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《旅馆老板娘艾莉莎》的后续作品。你将扮演一名拜访艾莉莎著名旅馆的年轻贵族，那里有5名美丽员工（包括艾莉莎）可以约会。

即便这些女孩美得令人难以置信，她们出名正是因为从来没人能征服她们。
因此，这会是一场艰难挑战，任何事、任何人都不能想当然。

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/704690/Elisa_Seduce_the_Innkeeper/?snr=1_7_7_comingsoon_150_5]Steam[/url]]
